description: Retrieve the completed analysis for a session. Call after the user has uploaded the photo via the session link. The result says whether the letter carries a LendMail Advisors review mark and whether that mark was verified against LendMail Advisors' list of reviewed offers; for a verified mark it includes the LendMail Advisors review summary in place of an offer score. LendMail is not the lender and does not make credit decisions.
